items.problem: `### export_user_snapshot` ("It can be called in every environment") and `### game state snapshot` (the same sentence for `export_game_state` and `sample_game_state`) have no test on a PROD server, though exporting from PROD is the purpose of the module. The only PROD module instance in the tests is server/core/user-snapshot-clone/tests/import.test.ts:431, and it calls only the import prepare functions; the test server runs as LOCAL. Run path: in a temporary copy, `if (server.env === 'PROD') return 'conflict';` was added at the start of the handlers of `export_user_snapshot`, `export_game_state` and `sample_game_state` in server/core/user-snapshot-clone/index.ts, and all 80 tests of the module still passed. The problem existed before the range: the range does not change the module or its tests.
